get.summary: WebSocket handler for WebRTC signaling.
get.description:
Upgrades to a WebSocket and exchanges WebRTC signaling over JSON **text
frames**. OpenAPI cannot type WebSocket message bodies, so the message
schema is documented here and as the `WebRtcSignalingMessage` component.

## Message envelope

Every frame is a JSON object discriminated by a lowercase `type` field
(see the `WebRtcSignalingMessage` schema). Note the field casing:
`icecandidate` (one word) with camelCase `sdpMid` / `sdpMLineIndex`.

## Typical flow (client-initiated, the common path)

1. **Server → client** `{"type":"offer","session_id":"<id>","sdp":"..."}`
   — the server sends its SDP offer immediately on connect.
2. **Client → server** `{"type":"answer","session_id":"<id>","sdp":"..."}`.
3. **Both directions** `{"type":"icecandidate","session_id":"<id>",`
   `"candidate":"candidate:...","sdpMid":"0","sdpMLineIndex":0}` — trickled
   as discovered.
4. **Server → client** `{"type":"ready","session_id":"<id>","monitor_id":N,`
   `"has_audio":false}` once media is flowing. `has_audio` tells the client
   whether an audio track accompanies the video.
5. **Errors** arrive as `{"type":"error","message":"..."}`.
6. **Keepalive**: either side may send `{"type":"ping"}`; the peer replies
   `{"type":"pong"}`.

101.description: WebSocket upgraded. Frames are JSON `WebRtcSignalingMessage` objects (text). Server sends `offer`/`ready`/`icecandidate`/`error`/`pong`; client sends `answer`/`icecandidate`/`ping`.

get.summary: List log entries with pagination and filtering.
get.description:
Filter by `component`, `min_level` (severity name — this severe or worse),
exact `level`, `search` (message substring), `start`/`end` (Unix seconds),
`server_id`, and `sort` (asc/desc by time; default newest-first).

parameters.name: min_level
parameters.description: Severity threshold: fatal|error|warning|info|debug, returns that severity or worse

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the message

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Only logs at or after this Unix time (seconds)

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only logs at or before this Unix time (seconds)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: asc (oldest first) or desc (newest first, default)

dataset_name.description: Name of the linked dataset, when the listing joins it.

framework.description: One of TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX, OpenVINO, TensorRT, Other.

cause.description: Short cause string (max 31 chars). Only used when action is "on". Default: "API"

score.description: Alarm score (1-100+). Only used when action is "on". Default: 100

text.description: Description text (max 255 chars). Only used when action is "on".

ApplyStateRequest.description: Request to apply a system state.

state_name.description: Name of the state to apply

AxisCapabilities.description: Capability flags for an axis (zoom, focus, iris, gain, white balance)

can.description: Can perform this operation at all

AxisRange.description: Range limits for a PTZ axis (pan, tilt, zoom, etc.)

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Self-service password change for the authenticated user (`PUT /me/password`).

num_classes.description: Number of classes the dataset defines (COCO = 80).

dataset_id.description: Dataset whose classes this model predicts.

model_path.description: Filesystem path to the model weights.

class_index.description: Index this class occupies in the model's output vector.

CreateFilterRequest.description:
Create a saved event filter. `name` and `query_json` are required; every
other column of the `Filters` table is optional and falls back to the
schema default when omitted (flags `0`, `execute_interval` `60`,
`email_format` `Individual`).

oneOf.description:
Structured, SQLi-safe filter AST. When present it is validated and
translated to ZoneMinder's flat `query_json` for storage.

query_json.description:
Raw ZoneMinder `query_json`. Optional when `filter` (the structured AST)
is supplied — in that case the AST is translated and wins.

event_id.description: Event ID this frame belongs to

frame_id.description: Frame sequence number within the event

enabled.description:
Whether the monitor is enabled (ZoneMinder's `Monitors.Enabled`).
Defaults to enabled when omitted.

allOf.description: Per-feature permission levels. Omitted features default to `View`.

api_enabled.description: Whether the user may authenticate to the API (`APIEnabled`).

DaemonListResponse.description: Response containing list of all daemons.

DaemonStatusResponse.description: Response containing a single daemon's status.

EventCountsByMonitorResponse.description: Response for event counts grouped by monitor

alarm_frames_min.description: Filter events with at least this many alarm frames

archived.description: Filter to show only archived events

cause.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the event cause.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the event name.

notes.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the event notes.

oneOf.description: Field to sort results by (default: start_time)

storage_id.description: Filter by the storage the event's media lives on.

tag_id.description:
Filter to events carrying any of these tag ids (comma-separated, e.g.
`tag_id=1,4,5`). Standard query strings can't repeat a key into a list,
so a comma-separated value is used.

EventSummary.description: Lightweight event summary for embedding in TagDetailResponse

EventSummaryResponse.description: Event counts and disk space summary for a monitor

archived_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by archived events (bytes)

day_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by events in the last day (bytes)

hour_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by events in the last hour (bytes)

month_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by events in the last month (bytes)

total_event_disk_space.description: Total disk space used by events (bytes)

week_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by events in the last week (bytes)

archived.description: Mark event as archived (protected from auto-deletion)

emailed.description: Mark event as having been emailed

executed.description: Mark event as having triggered an external action

locked.description: Lock event to prevent deletion by filters

messaged.description: Mark event as having been sent via push notification

uploaded.description: Mark event as having been uploaded to external storage

in_progress.description:
True while the event is still recording (no `EndDateTime`). Codec/size
fields may be unknown until it finalizes; play via `playlist.m3u8`.

playable_direct.description:
True when the codec plays in any browser `<video>` (H.264). HEVC is
Safari / hardware-Chrome only.

recommended_mode.description:
Suggested playback endpoint: "direct" (progressive MP4), "hls" (VOD), or
"event" (in-progress live HLS via `playlist.m3u8`).

oneOf.description:
A bracketed group — `match` joins its `rules` with AND (`all`) or OR
(`any`). Nesting groups gives arbitrarily deep brackets.

value.description:
The comparison value. Omitted for `is_null`/`is_not_null`; an array
for `in`/`not_in`; otherwise a scalar. Always treated as data.

FilterExpr.description:
One node of the filter tree: either a bracketed group of sub-expressions
joined by AND/OR, or a single leaf condition.

FilterField.description:
Whitelisted attributes a filter may reference. Each maps to a real column
(and a ZoneMinder attribute name) in `service::filter_field`. Most are
`Events` columns; a few are joined `Monitors`/`Storage` attributes.

FilterOp.description:
Comparison operators a condition may use. A closed set mapped to fixed SQL
operators downstream — never interpolated.

FilterQuery.description:
A complete structured filter query: a root predicate plus optional sort and
row limit.

limit.description: Optional row limit applied by the downstream executor.

FilterResponse.description:
A saved event filter. Mirrors every column of the `Filters` table so the API
(and its OpenAPI schema) faithfully represents a ZoneMinder filter rather
than a lossy subset.

oneOf.description:
The stored `query_json` parsed into the structured AST, when it maps to
our vocabulary. `None` for legacy/unmodelled filters. Populated by the
service layer (the `From<&Model>` conversion leaves it `None`).

event_id.description: Event ID this frame belongs to

frame_id.description: Frame sequence number within the event

Level.description: A permission level, ordered `None < View < Edit`.

oneOf.description:
Most-recent WebRTC startup profile (connect→offer→first-RTP), when a
session has run since boot. Lets you confirm cold-vs-warm empirically.

LocaleResponse.description:
Server locale: the effective timezone + ZoneMinder's date/time format
patterns, so clients can render server-local time consistently with the
legacy web UI (GH #33). Pairs with event timestamps now being true UTC.

timezone.description:
Effective IANA timezone name (from ZoneMinder's `ZM_TIMEZONE`, or the
host OS zone when that is empty). May be `null` if it can't be resolved.

utc_offset.description: Current UTC offset of the server, e.g. `+10:00`.

utc_offset_seconds.description: Current UTC offset in seconds (e.g. 36000 for +10:00).

LogLevel.description:
A ZoneMinder log severity, named instead of numeric.

ZoneMinder's `Logs.Level` scale is inverted — more negative is more severe
(`0`=Info, `-1`=Warning, `-2`=Error, `-3`=Fatal; positive values are debug
levels). Clients should filter by name via `min_level` rather than reasoning
about the numeric direction.

LogQueryParams.description: Query parameters for listing (and clearing) logs.

end.description: Only logs at or before this Unix time (seconds; `TimeKey`).

level.description:
Exact `Logs.Level` value match (ZoneMinder's inverted numeric scale:
0=Info, -1=Warning, -2=Error, -3=Fatal, positive=debug). For "this
severe or worse", use `min_level` instead.

oneOf.description:
Filter to this severity **or worse** (`fatal` < `error` < `warning` <
`info` < `debug`). E.g. `min_level=error` returns errors and fatals.
Preferred over the raw numeric `level`.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the log message.

oneOf.description: Sort by time: `asc` (oldest first) or `desc` (newest first, default).

start.description: Only logs at or after this Unix time (seconds; `TimeKey`).

file.description: Source file that generated the log

line.description: Line number in the source file

pid.description: Process ID that generated the log

time_key.description: Timestamp as Unix epoch with microseconds (e.g., 1234567890.123456)

LogSort.description: Sort direction for the log time (`TimeKey`).

MeResponse.description:
The authenticated caller's account plus the metadata carried by their
current access token, so a client can show "signed in as / expires at"
without decoding the JWT itself (GH #37).

MonitorEventCount.description: Event count per monitor (for console view)

MonitorPipelineResponse.description: A monitor's stored zm-next processing plugin graph (the "free graph").

analysis_image_opacity.description: Alpha applied when compositing the analysis image over the frame (0-255).

object_detection.description: Per-monitor object detection: the detector in use (`none` when off).

object_detection_model.description: Name of the AI model used for object detection.

stream_channel.description:
Stream source channel. Replaces the old `RTSP2WebStream` column, which
ZoneMinder renamed to `StreamChannel` in 1.37.79.

what_display.description: What the live view renders: video, audio visualization, or both.

ProcessState.description: State of a managed daemon process.

PtzCapabilities.description: Complete PTZ capabilities for a camera

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds (optional, for timed movements)

name.description:
Optional name for the preset (when setting). The character set is
restricted to keep names safe to log, store, and pass downstream as
a single argv element to zmcontrol.pl: NUL truncates C strings,
newlines enable log injection, and slashes have no business in a
preset label. The first character may not be `-` either, since a
leading hyphen makes the value indistinguishable from a flag to the
Perl Getopt::Long parser on the receiving end. Any printable,
non-control, non-slash character is OK after that, including Unicode
letters (so non-Latin names still work).

is_native.description: Whether this is a native Rust implementation

SearchCitation.description: One retrieved event in a search response — the verifiable ground truth.

score.description:
Relevance score (reranker score when reranking is on, else the RRF score;
higher is better).

snippet.description: Snippet of the indexed description text.

url.description: API path to the full event.

from.description: Inclusive lower time bound, epoch seconds.

k.description: Number of results to return (1–50, default 10).

monitor_id.description: Restrict to a single monitor (still subject to the caller's ACL).

q.example: a person near the front door at night

to.description: Inclusive upper time bound, epoch seconds.

answer.description:
Grounded NL answer when the router LLM is reachable; else `null` and the
client renders the citations directly.

count.description: Exact count from the SQL count tool for "how many …" queries; else `null`.

zmstats.description:
Per-daemon enable flags (0/1). ZoneMinder's `Servers` table has no
`zmtelemetry` column, so only these four are exposed.

k.description: Number of results to return (1–50, default 10).

citations.description: Events nearest the source event's embedding.

StartLiveRequest.description: Request to start a live stream

StartLiveResponse.description: Response for starting a live stream

disk_space.description: Configured capacity in bytes (`Storages.DiskSpace`), if set.

db_connections.description:
Database connections currently held by the pool (the legacy header's
`DB: n/max`). `None` when the pool cannot be inspected.

db_max_connections.description: Configured maximum size of the database connection pool.

total_disk.description: Total disk space in bytes (root filesystem)

running.description: Whether the daemon controller is running

TagDetailResponse.description: Tag detail response with paginated events

event_count.description: Number of events with this tag

TagSummary.description: Lightweight tag summary for embedding in EventResponse

TokenType.description:
Which of the two token kinds a JWT is. Access and refresh tokens are
otherwise structurally identical `UserClaims`, separated only by the key
pair that signs them; `typ` makes the distinction explicit so a
misconfiguration that pointed both key paths at the same pair could not
silently let a refresh token act as an access token (or vice versa).

dataset_id.description: Set to re-point the model at another dataset. `null` clears it.

UpdateFilterRequest.description:
Patch a saved event filter. Every field is optional; only the ones provided
are changed.

oneOf.description: Structured filter AST; when present it is translated to `query_json`.

parent_id.description:
Re-parent the group. Omit to leave the parent unchanged; `null` clears
it (top-level group); a group id nests under that group. Self-parenting
and cycles are rejected (GH #28).

analysis_image_opacity.description: Alpha applied when compositing the analysis image over the frame.

object_detection.description: Detector to use, or `none` to disable object detection.

object_detection_model.description: Name of the AI model used for object detection.

password.description: New password (re-hashed with bcrypt; never stored in plaintext).

token_min_expiry.description:
Set the token-revocation floor (unix seconds). Setting it to "now"
revokes all of the user's outstanding tokens (admin revoke-all).

UpdateUserRequest.description: Partial update: every field is optional and only provided fields change.

UserPermissions.description: A snapshot of a user's per-feature permission levels, embedded in the JWT.

UserPermissionsInput.description:
The eight ZoneMinder per-feature permission levels. Each is optional so a
request can set only the ones it cares about.

Values are the same names `UserResponse` reports: `None` / `View` / `Edit`
(`Stream` has no `Edit`; `Monitors` also accepts `Create`). They are taken
as strings and parsed, because the generated entity enums do not derive
`ToSchema` and `src/entity/` is a generated artifact we don't hand-edit.

has_audio.description:
Whether the session carries an audio track (G.711 pass-through
or AAC transcoded to Opus) alongside the video track

WebRtcSignalingMessage.description:
WebRTC signaling message types.

This is the *actual* wire format exchanged over the
`/api/v3/live/{monitor_id}/webrtc/ws` WebSocket (text frames, JSON). The
discriminator is the `type` field, lowercased: `offer`, `answer`,
`icecandidate`, `ready`, `error`, `ping`, `pong`.

WebRtcStartupView.description:
Server-side WebRTC startup timing surfaced on `/live/{id}/stats`. All `*_ms`
are from WS connect and nest: `get_source_ms ≤ offer_ms ≤ ice_connected_ms ≤
connected_ms ≤ first_rtp_ms`.

connected_ms.description:
connect → peer Connected (ICE+DTLS). `connected_ms − ice_connected_ms` is
the DTLS handshake (the structural ~1.1s offerer-passive cost on a LAN).

offer_ms.description:
connect → SDP offer sent. With trickle ICE this no longer waits on ICE
gathering / STUN, so it collapses toward the floor.

warm_start.description: Reader was already hot at connect (no reader spin-up on the offer path).
